scope: Mobile orientation, explicit test settings, and device testing guidance

validation.roslyn_csharp9_syntax: Passed for project scripts; UNITY_EDITOR with Legacy, Input System, and no input define.
validation.editor_settings_api: Reviewed against Unity 6000.3 API: Android autoRotationBehavior, minSupportedSdkVersion, ARM64/IL2CPP and NamedBuildTarget.
validation.scene_list: Current saved scene enabled first; other entries and enabled state preserved. Unsaved scene emits warning. Build Profile custom overrides require manual check.
validation.runtime: Only Application.isMobilePlatform; landscape left/right, portrait disabled, 60 FPS target, reapplied on resume/focus.
validation.custom_identity_and_signing: Preserves custom Bundle IDs and all signing credentials; no Apple Team, release keystore, platform switch or build invocation.
validation.initialization: Landscape defaults applied only once for standalone project with IntercomMvpProject.json; Assets-only imports require explicit setup.
validation.limitation: Unity Editor and platform build tools were unavailable. Syntax/API review does not establish Unity compilation or runtime success.
